newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Norfolk, Va..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Norfolk, Va..

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the City of Norfolk (the City''), a municipal corporation of the Commonwealth of Virginia, at 10:30 a.m. E.D.T. on the date indicated below for the purchase of $43,975,000* General Obligation Capital Improvement Bonds, Series 1997 (the Governmental Bonds'') and at 11:00 a.m. E.D.T. on the date indicated below for the purchase of $4,000,000* General Obligation Qualified
Redevelopment Bonds, Series 1997 (AMT) (the Qualified Redevelopment Bonds''), (collectively, the

Bids will be received at the Office of the City Manager, Room 1101, City Hall Building, 810 Union Street, Norfolk, Virginia 23510, and will be subject to the terms and conditions of the complete Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be general obligations of the City of Norfolk, Virginia, and the full faith and credit of the City are pledged to the payment of the principal of and interest on the Bonds.

The Governmental Bonds will be dated April 15, 1997, will bear interest payable on June 1 and December 1 of each year to maturity, commencing December 1, 1997, and will mature in annual installments on June 1 as set forth below:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Qualified Redevelopment Bonds will be dated April 15, 1997, will bear interest payable on June 1 and December 1 of each year to maturity, commencing December 1, 1997, and will mature in annual installments on June 1 as set forth below:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The City reserves the right to change the principal maturity schedules shown above by announcing any such change not later than 2:00 P.M., E.D.T. on the business day prior to the date fixed for the receipt of bids and sale of the Bonds by the Munifacts Wire System, Inc. The resulting schedule of maturities (the Governmental Bid Maturity Schedule'' and the

Schedule'') may or may not be identical to the initial maturity schedules. Furthermore, if no such change is announced, the initial maturity schedules will become the Governmental Bid Maturity Schedule and the Qualified

Redevelopment Bid Maturity Schedule. Prospective bidders may request notification of any such changes by contacting the City's Financial Advisor, Public Financial Management, Inc., (215) 567-6100 (Attention: Lloyd Cheu). The City also reserves the right to postpone the date established for the receipt of bids as described in the complete Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be issued in registered form by means of a book-entry system with no physical distribution of bond certificates made to the public. One bond certificate for each maturity will be issued to The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC''), and immobilized in its custody. The Bonds that mature on or after June 1, 2008, are subject to redemption on or after June 1, 2007, as described in the complete Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be delivered to DTC on or about May 14, 1997, in New York, New York upon payment of the balance due on the total purchase price in FEDERAL FUNDS. The approving legal opinion of McGuire, Woods, Battle & Boothe, L.L.P., Richmond, Virginia, will be furnished

without cost to the purchaser. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Official Bid Form for the Bonds or further information may be obtained without cost from the City's Financial Advisor, Public Financial Management, Inc., Two Logan Square, Suite 1600, 18th and Arch Streets, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania 19103, (215) 567-6100 (Attention: Lloyd Cheu), or from the Office of the Director of Finance, Room 1003, City Hall Building, 810 Union Street, Norfolk, Virginia 23510, (757) 664-4346.
By: JAMES B. OLIVER, JR., City Manage
